attributes.name: regionId

attributes.name: sourceSha256

csv.stringEscape: Prefix a literal leading backslash or apostrophe with backslash; decode once, in text cells only.
csv.formulaPolicy: Prefix formula-leading text (=,+,-,@ after Unicode whitespace or Cc/Cf control/format characters) and text beginning with tab/CR/LF with apostrophe. Preserve typed numeric cells; inverse decoding restores original text. snapshot.json is lossless authority.
csv.typedValueColumns: Fact/CalculationValue/ReviewField.value with unit=money_minor is canonical signed64 minor text. Canonical values with unit=number/percentage/months/years use exact decimal text; other values remain protected text.
